colors.rules: No full-screen gradients. Deep charcoal/ink black for main backgrounds, warm champagne cream for inner contrasting sections. Luminous gold (#D4AF37) is the ONLY accent color used for delicate hairlines, hovers, and focal elements.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Deep, matte backgrounds with very subtle noise/grain texture overlay (opacity 0.03).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px hairline borders in border-white/10 or border-[#D4AF37]/30. Clipped-frame product photography with gold hairline borders.
visual_enhancers.effects: Gold underlines that draw on hover, cursor-follow spotlight in one section. Do NOT use heavy box-shadows; rely on clipping and high contrast.

layouts.banner: Dismissible top banner (Launch Special). Minimalist, dark gray bg, small uppercase gold text.
layouts.nav: Glassmorphism nav (backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) with subtle 1px border-white/10. Logo left, centered links, gold outlined CTA right.
layouts.hero: Giant kinetic serif wordmark revealing line-by-line via clip-path masks. Small numbered captions floating like magazine markers. 3D subtle tilt or parallax on a spa-detail shot or abstract gold liquid.
layouts.manifesto: Numbered chapters ('01 — THE PHILOSOPHY'). Large typography, lots of negative space, staggered fade-ups.
layouts.marquee: Slow editorial marquee band ('BEAUTY · WELLNESS · CONFIDENCE · RENEWAL'). Serif font, gold or white text on dark background, widely spaced.
layouts.services: Tabbed editorial layout or strict bento grid categorizing Injectables, Biostimulators, Skin Rejuvenation, IV Hydration. Clear pricing. 1px borders.
layouts.founder_spotlight: Editorial spotlight on Crystal G. Marrero, FNP-C. Clipped portrait with gold borders, maybe a subtle parallax motion. '02 — THE FOUNDER' label.
layouts.booking_form: Minimalist inputs, bottom borders only (border-white/20 focus:border-[#D4AF37]). Submit button is a sharp rectangle or subtle pill with gold hover.
layouts.testimonials: Editorial masonry or elegant fading carousel. Large quote marks in a light serif.
layouts.footer: Massive typography for 'OVERALL BEAUTY'. Contact details, location, hours on a strict grid.

components.buttons: Sharp rectangular or pill-shaped buttons. Primary CTA uses gold background with ink black text. Secondary CTA uses transparent bg, 1px gold or white border, hover fills with gold.
components.cards: Cardless or highly restrained 1px bordered containers. No drop shadows. Use padding like p-8 or p-12 to let content breathe.
components.inputs: Floating labels or stark minimalist bottom borders. Background transparent. Focus states must shift border to luminous gold.
components.dividers: 1px horizontal rules using border-[#D4AF37]/20 or border-white/10.

motion.hero_reveal: Framer motion: use initial={{ clipPath: 'inset(100% 0 0 0)' }} animate={{ clipPath: 'inset(0% 0 0 0)' }} for line-by-line serif text reveals.
motion.scroll: Lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. Setup in an overarching layout component.
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on links trigger a gold 1px underline expanding from center (scaleX). Buttons use slight scale or color fill. Staggered fade-up for manifesto elements.
motion.parallax: Use useScroll and useTransform for a slow vertical drift on the founder portrait or hero image.

accessibility.contrast: Text over dark backgrounds must meet WCAG AA contrast. Use #FFFFFF for primary text, #A3A3A3 for secondary. Buttons must have clear focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='submit-consultation-btn').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for complex Framer Motion animations.

instructions_to_main_agent.framework: React (with .js extensions, not .tsx) + Tailwind CSS. Must install framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/react-lenis), lucide-react, sonner.
general_ui_ux: No generic templates or default component looks. Push the 'Editorial luxury noir' vibe.
Never use pure transparent backgrounds on sticky headers; use backdrop-blur-xl with a dark tint.
Avoid universal 'transition: all' which breaks Framer animations.
Use ample negative space. Awwwards level requires tight precision with typography (tracking, line-height).
Do not use generic font variants. Stick to Cormorant Garamond for headings and Manrope for body text.
Include micro-animations for every interaction (hover states, form focus, button click).
Form integration: use standard React fetch logic assuming a backend route for Resend/Mongo exists, but make the UI stateful (loading, success, error) and notify via Sonner toast.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_aesthetics: Create depth through layered design elements and z-index hierarchy. Avoid generic centered layouts and simplistic gradients.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.interaction: Every interaction needs micro-animations. Use modern pill-shaped or sharp rectangular buttons. NEVER use AI assistant Emojis.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.spacing: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.components: Use sonner for toasts. Customize Shadcn elements completely if used, to remove default 'Vercel-look'.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.files: You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components in JS.
